decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-41df2d850c70] and the PR title [ev-ab58a6dbcec8] name the subject: the error messages shown when a sync of a StatefulSet fails because it changes an immutable field. They also say the change is that these messages were improved, and the PR lists it as a feature, not a breaking change. The changed-files list [ev-7c87909a66c6] shows the Argo CD side touches only two UI files (application-operation-state.tsx, utils.tsx). So this is a change to how the UI shows these errors, with no config key, default or behaviour change. That points to an informational consequence: no action is needed, and only users who hit StatefulSet immutable-field sync errors would notice. The exact before/after wording is not shown, and neither is the gitops-engine dependency (PR 654) that [ev-ab58a6dbcec8] mentions. That is why confidence is low, but the change type and consequence class can still be decided.
